# Martin Ferret

> TypeScript expert focused on type-checking performance. Contributor to TypeScript’s DOM types. Lead Content Owner for the JavaScript and TypeScript certifications at Certificates.dev. Based in France, working remotely across Europe.

Last updated: 2026-11-11. Every claim on this site links to a source.
Contact: mferret.pro@gmail.com
